ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, May 4, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to Technical Systems Management students on Monday, May 11, 2020 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 300 is offered online in the summer and winter terms as well as this fall term. No exceptions will be made. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
